title: Earth's next ice age may have already begun. Global warming stopped it

By studying ancient plants preserved beneath the Barnes Ice Cap in the Canadian Arctic, researchers discovered that the remnants of a massive ice sheet began expanding again about 2,000 years ago, signaling the possible start of a new glacial period. But by the 1960s, rising temperatures had reversed that growth, causing the ice to shrink instead.

title: Earth’s ancient oceans may have fooled scientists about its oxygen history

title: A giant star swallowed another star. James Webb reveals the aftermath

title: After 8 years in space, a groundbreaking X-ray telescope finally opens its eyes

title: Einstein’s relativity just upended a fundamental rule of chemistry
